emotion_styles.joy: uplifting composition, open framing, lively movement, warm luminous highlights
emotion_styles.sadness: quiet composition, restrained motion, reflective atmosphere, soft diffused light
emotion_styles.hope: rising perspective, widening horizons, gradual light bloom, forward-moving camera
emotion_styles.anger: dynamic low angles, decisive motion, strong contrast, dramatic lighting
emotion_styles.love: intimate framing, gentle camera drift, soft highlights, harmonious visual rhythm
emotion_styles.fear: deep shadows, partial silhouettes, cautious camera movement, atmospheric tension
emotion_styles.nostalgia: soft film grain, gentle halation, warm faded highlights, unhurried camera movement
emotion_styles.wonder: expansive scale, floating particles, slow reveal, luminous atmospheric depth

character.description: The same young adult woman anime protagonist throughout the full music video: dark brown hair in a loose high ponytail, clear grey eyes, with a distinct consistent face and adult proportions. Their role is a rooftop gardener who turns forgotten city spaces into small green refuges. Fixed signature outfit: a practical denim jacket over a sage-green jumpsuit, utility belt, and high-top shoes. Defining personal item: a small watering can covered in hand-painted rooftop flowers. Preserve the exact face, hair shape and color, eye color, body proportions, outfit silhouette, and defining item in every scene.
consistency_rules: This theme follows one fixed protagonist identity from the opening to the finale.
Keep the same face, hairstyle, hair color, eye color, adult age impression, and body proportions.
Maintain the signature costume silhouette, colors, and defining personal item in every scene.
Do not substitute the protagonist or add a second lead unless the lyrics explicitly require it.

visual_language.action_style: expressive, readable full-body gestures; natural movement; clear pose silhouettes; avoid static repeated poses
visual_language.environment_style: rich anime background design rooted in high-rise rooftops at blue hour, distant illuminated skylines, windy rooftop gardens; preserve the theme's distinctive world and recognizable environmental details
visual_language.lighting_style: cinematic lighting harmonized with midnight navy, neon pink, concrete gray; coherent light direction, atmospheric depth, and controlled highlights
visual_language.composition_style: varied cinematic framing informed by wide establishing shot with layered depth, slow cinematic dolly-in with stable horizon, gentle lateral tracking shot revealing environmental detail; clear subject separation and intentional negative space
